corpus_invariant.text: bfdm-corpus is not primarily a training dataset. It is the durable research archive of Brendon's D&D creative history. Kit is one consumer of it.
corpus_invariant.operational_rule: Archive integrity and long-term research value outrank convenience for any current Kit implementation; model-facing datasets are downstream derivatives.
